name: pluto
description: Use TalentPluto's live recruiting workflows, privacy-filtered candidate discovery, bulk candidate work-email enrichment, LinkedIn profile enrichment, deep candidate enrichment with validated emails and derived employment-company intelligence, client-shared candidate rubrics, candidate-to-Team DNA comparison, evidence-backed candidate scoring against Team DNA, a job description, or a saved rubric, outbound campaigns through single-email personal inbox drafts, Pluto-managed inboxes, or dedicated campaign inboxes, and privacy-thresholded market snapshots through a stable, authenticated Pluto connection.

interface.shortDescription: Use TalentPluto recruiting, rubrics, outbound, and market tools.
interface.longDescription: Connect once to use TalentPluto's live recruiting, candidate-email enrichment, LinkedIn profile enrichment, deep candidate enrichment with validated emails and derived employment-company intelligence, client-shared candidate rubrics, candidate-to-Team DNA comparison, evidence-backed candidate scoring against Team DNA, a job description, or a saved rubric, reviewable outbound campaigns through single-email personal inbox drafts, Pluto-managed inboxes, or dedicated campaign inboxes, confirmed campaign cancellation, and market-insight workflows in Codex. Pluto advertises its current tools and input contracts from its MCP server, and consequential actions require explicit user direction.
defaultPrompt: Use Pluto to help with this recruiting task.
Find AI engineers with 1+ years of professional experience in New York.
Find people who match this pasted job description.
Give me a directional US market snapshot for engineering talent.
How many Pluto credits do I have left, and when do they reset?
Ask whether the selected in-network candidate's recorded preference is compatible with a $180,000 annual base salary.
Get and verify the available emails for the candidates I selected.
Get the full public profiles for the LinkedIn profile URLs I supplied.
Deep-enrich the LinkedIn profiles I selected with professional profiles, validated emails, and derived employment-company intelligence.
How does the background of the candidate I supplied overlap with our Team DNA?
Show me my saved candidate rubrics.
Create a candidate rubric from this job description and let me review it before saving.
Score the candidate I selected against our Team DNA, this job description, or one of my saved rubrics.
Create a campaign for the out-of-network candidates I selected. Load my defaults and saved templates, draft one complete editable review, and ask me to confirm that exact campaign.
Cancel my outbound campaign for the payments role.
Continue with the candidate and role I selected in Pluto.
